summary: Goat Simulator entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Goat Simulator
entries.definitive_edition: Goat Simulator: Remastered on PC, with original 2014 build documented for launch-state comparison

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC remaster for content; original PC build for historical behavior

primary.why: Goat Simulator: Remastered is the current completeness route, with the original game's DLC included plus an additional mobile map, while keeping PC as the best capture/settings path. The 2014 original remains useful if documenting launch-version bugs and older physics behavior.
primary.how_to_play: Use Goat Simulator: Remastered on PC. Record build, graphics settings, DLC/map checklist, mutator menu state, controller/keyboard, co-op/multiplayer state, and whether the original 2014 build was compared.

secondary.exclusive_content: Launch physics/bug behavior and original DLC progression context
secondary.what_to_play: Use if documenting the original release state.
secondary.why: The remaster is more complete, but the old build is historically distinct.

secondary.exclusive_content: Platform-specific controls and mobile map history
secondary.why: PC remaster is the best capture and content route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record remaster build and which DLC/maps are complete; old bugs may not match the 2014 original.
